title: ateramnus lucidus
intro: Ateramnus lucidus, commonly known as the "sleepy grass" or "sleepy weed", is a plant species that belongs to the family Malpighiaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Ateramnus lucidus are attributed to its ability to reduce cortisol levels, sedate the nervous system, and promote a sense of calmness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its sedative and anxiolytic effects.
